'''Varad Zagg''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who lived at the ruins of the [[Sith Academy (Umbara)|Sith Academy]] on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] entered the Academy and confronted Varad, who created projections of [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to test the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. After the Jedi Knight dispatched of the projections, Varad threw bursts of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] along with summoning [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]] to attack the Jedi. He fought bravely, but eventually [[Death/Legends|died]], his last words being "No, I have failed my [[Sith Order|order]]".<ref name="CWA" />
